description: You are an environmental scientist working for the Emilia-Romagna Regional Environmental Agency (ARPAE). Bologna is considering implementing a Low Emission Zone (LEZ) in the Pasubio corridor to reduce air pollution. You must conduct a before-after emission impact study using SUMO's built-in emission modeling capabilities. Using the Bologna Pasubio scenario, you must: (1) Configure the simulation to produce per-vehicle emission output using SUMO's emission tracking. Add the emission output option to the simulation configuration so that aggregate emission data is written to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_emissions.xml. The scenario already uses HBEFA2 emission classes in its vehicle type definitions. Run the baseline simulation and save the emission output. (2) Implement a Low Emission Zone by creating a modified scenario where older, high-polluting vehicle types are restricted from using at least 5 edges in the core zone. This can be done by: (a) creating a 'disallow' attribute on selected edges to prohibit certain vehicle classes, OR (b) modifying vehicle routes to avoid the restricted zone, OR (c) removing high-emission vehicle types and replacing them with cleaner alternatives (e.g., changing emissionClass from HBEFA2/P_7_7 to HBEFA2/P_7_1 for Euro-6 equivalent). You must use at least TWO of these three strategies. (3) Run the modified LEZ simulation and save emission output to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/lez_emissions.xml. (4) Produce an emission impact assessment CSV at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/emission_impact_report.csv with columns: pollutant,baseline_total_mg,lez_total_mg,reduction_pct. Required pollutant rows: CO2, CO, NOx, PMx, HC. (5) Write a professional environmental impact summary to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/emission_impact_summary.txt documenting the LEZ design, emission reductions achieved, and policy recommendations. Include specific numerical results. The scenario is at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_pasubio/.
